procedure: State: The same manuscript comparison includes a patch with a possibly persistent erased underlayer and documented probe behavior. Procedure: Maintain the anomaly catalogue. Apply the available probe within documented damage limits, compare the localized response with its blanks and known positives, and record response or nonresponse. Limits and stopping conditions: Interfering materials can respond; degradation can prevent response; damage limits apply. Nonresponse is not proof of no prior writing.
action: Maintain the anomaly catalogue. Apply the available probe within documented damage limits, compare the localized response with its blanks and known positives, and record response or nonresponse.
observables: An otherwise invisible localized material response, plus blank and positive-control responses.
inferential_warrant: A response supports presence/location of responsive material, not a particular past event. The separately supplied overlay relation makes an actual underlayer a bounded pre-overwriting constraint; identifying or dating a reading requires independent evidence.
problem_decomposition: Keep ordinary patch, witness and revision-account units; no new complete-history model.
next_inquiry: Return to ordinary witness collation or correspondence with the localized finding; no new follow-up-selection rule.
